description: Source file for the FrontPanel plugin, implementing API methods for controlling front panel indicators, LEDs, clock, and display patterns, including event handling and configuration management.

classes.name: TestPatternInfo
classes.description: Class managing the timing for LED text pattern updates.

classes.name: FrontPanel
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing front panel control API, event handling, and configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers API methods, and starts necessary components.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: powerModeChange
methods.description: Handles power mode change events from IARM bus.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus communication and registers event handlers.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes IARM event handlers and cleans up.

methods.name: setResponseArray
methods.description: Helper to set array responses in JSON.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the front panel indicator.

methods.name: setBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setBrightness API method.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current brightness of the front panel indicator.

methods.name: getBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for getBrightness API method.

methods.name: powerLedOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified front panel LED.

methods.name: powerLedOnWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for powerLedOn API method.

methods.name: powerLedOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified front panel LED.

methods.name: powerLedOffWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for powerLedOff API method.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the clock display brightness if enabled.

methods.name: setClockBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setClockBrightness API method.

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the clock display brightness if enabled.

methods.name: getClockBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for getClockBrightness API method.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Returns list of controllable front panel lights.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsInfo
methods.description: Returns detailed info about front panel lights.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for getFrontPanelLights API method.

methods.description: Retrieves current front panel preferences.

methods.description: Stores preferences into persistent storage.

methods.description: Loads preferences from storage.

methods.name: getPreferencesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for getPreferences API method.

methods.name: setPreferencesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setPreferences API method.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets properties of a specific LED.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Sets blinking pattern for an LED.

methods.description: Sets 24-hour clock format.

methods.description: Returns whether 24-hour clock format is enabled.

methods.description: Enables or disables test pattern display on clock.
